root.label: Fulton County jail leadership resignations and corrective actions

events.label: Fulton County jail leadership resignations and corrective actions

slots.name: team experience
slots.unit: years of jail administration and law enforcement experience
slots.sentence: “Collectively, the executive team that’s been in place has more than 65 years of jail administration and law enforcement experience.

slots.name: emergency expense
slots.sentence: On Friday, the sheriff’s office said “several immediate actions” had already been taken, including a $500,000 emergency expense “to address the infestation of bed bugs, lice and other vermin” within the jail.

slots.name: inmates transferred
slots.sentence: A process to transfer more than 600 inmates to other counties “in an effort to help relieve overcrowding, at an average cost of approximately $40K/day,” had also begun, the sheriff’s office said.

slots.name: officials stepped down
slots.sentence: Three officials at the Fulton County, Georgia, jail have stepped down amid an investigation into the death of an inmate whose family said was housed in a filthy, bug-infested cell that “was not fit for a diseased animal.”
